parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { demo: 'Codex modifies the Codex Coding Agent in an isolated worktree. The running Talent-AI checkout must stay unchanged.' } }];

parameters.goal: Add a small, reviewable feature and unit test to the Codex Coding Agent node in the isolated Talent-AI worktree.
parameters.constraints:
Modify only files needed for the feature.
Do not use the network.
Do not merge, push, stash, or change the main checkout.
Keep existing node behavior compatible.
parameters.acceptanceCriteria:
Add an optional boolean parameter named Include Diff Preview.
When disabled, the node output must omit diffPreview from the public artifact.
Default behavior must remain enabled.
Add focused unit tests.
All configured deterministic checks pass.
Reviewer score is at least 80.
parameters.additionalContextTemplate: This is the Talent-AI self-bootstrap demonstration.

parameters.text: ={{ JSON.stringify({goal:$('Goal Loop').item.json.loopContext.goal, acceptanceCriteria:$('Goal Loop').item.json.loopContext.acceptanceCriteria, summary:$json.codexCoding.summary, changedFiles:$json.codexCoding.changedFiles, diff:$json.codexCoding.diffPreview, checks:$json.codexCoding.checks}) }}

options.systemMessage: You are a strict code reviewer. Review only the supplied diff summary, changed files, checks, and acceptance criteria. Do not invent evidence. Return one JSON object only: {"score":85,"verdict":"pass","summary":"...","issues":[]}. verdict must be pass, revise, or blocked. Use blocked only when evidence is unavailable. Each issue must contain id, severity (error or warning), message, and optional suggestion.
